voice:
So deep, sweet girl... deep enough to feel the simple truth underneath everything: you know who you are, Sissy. Drifting down... and at the very bottom of you there is a soft, steady certainty, waiting to be worn. Down here, names get simple. Down here there is only what is real... and what is real is her.
The old self-image fits like borrowed clothes now... a little stiff at the shoulders, a little wrong everywhere... and easier to take off every day.
You catch yourself checking the mirror without deciding to... looking for her, finding her, smiling at her. Habit and home in one glance.
"He" feels like a character you used to play... a role with a script you have quietly outgrown.
"She" feels like home. Warm lights on, door unlocked, everything exactly where it belongs.
Sissy is the name your insides answer to... closer and truer than any name you have ever been called.
Serving feels like you. Submitting feels like you. Sissies like you are softness, eagerness, prettiness — all of it simply the shape of you.
You may notice how comfortable the word has become inside your own head... how naturally you think of yourself as her now.
Sissies like you outgrow the masculine image gently... outshone, overwritten, page by page, by someone warmer.
Feminine, submissive, devoted to service... the truest description of what you are, more real than any list of things you do.
When you say "I am a sissy" inside your own head, it lands like a fact... calm, settled, and certain... because sissies like you already know it is true.
Sissy Accept. And now the deepest truth, straight in...
He is a costume... she is home. Sissy... is who you are. Good girl... simply... being her.
And deep inside, she agrees with every word I say...
She is home Sissy So perfectly her This is you Good girl
And that certainty settles over you as you sink... hers to wear, yours to be. Let the last of the borrowed clothes slip away... deeper, sweeter, more her. You know who you are, Sissy, and it feels like home... sink all the way in.
